story.titleZh: 威廉姆斯F1车队宣布首个赛车夏令营，将于2027年夏在奥斯汀举行
story.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯F1车队宣布首个赛车夏令营将于2027年夏在奥斯汀举行，为期一周的夏令营将让9至11岁的孩子有机会亲身体验一级方程式赛车世界。

story.originalTitle: We’re excited to announce the first ever Williams F1 Team x Racing Camp, taking place in Austin, Texas in summer 2027. This immersive, week-long day ...
story.summaryEn:
We’re excited to announce the first ever Williams F1 Team x Racing Camp, taking place in Austin, Texas in summer 2027.
This immersive, week-long day camp will give kids aged 9-11 the chance to step into the world of Formula 1, with hands-on activities developed and led by members of Atlassian Williams F1 Team.
Building on the success of our Grove programme, the US Summer Camps mark another step in Williams' commitment to supporting the talent of the future, and helping them build the skills, confidence, and enthusiasm they need for future studies or careers.
You can read more about the programme, and how to get involved:
https://www.williamsf1.com/articles/bb281da7-ca47-4304-8af0-56d90c46e593/williams-f1-team-x-racing-camp-coming-to-austin-in-summer-2027
detailZh:
我们非常激动地宣布，首届威廉姆斯一级方程式车队x赛车训练营将于2027年夏天在德克萨斯州的奥斯汀举行。
这个沉浸式的一周日间训练营将为9至11岁的孩子们提供一个机会，让他们亲身体验一级方程式的世界，活动由阿特拉斯安联威廉姆斯一级方程式车队成员开发和领导。
在成功推出我们的格罗夫项目的基础上，美国夏日训练营标志着威廉姆斯车队在支持未来人才方面的又一举措，帮助他们培养未来学习或职业生涯所需的技能、自信和热情。
您可以了解更多关于该计划以及如何参与的信息：
https://www.williamsf1.com/articles/bb281da7-ca47-4304-8af0-56d90c46e593/威廉姆斯-f1-team-x-racing-camp-coming-to-austin-in-summer-2027
